args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 of checkout-api to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with change-manager approval. This replaces v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in production with an 18% error rate. Incident opened to record the change; verify error rates return to baseline post-rollout.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what was completed:

1. **Pre-checks**: Confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production (18% error rate) and that v2.3.2 had never been deployed to production — meaning the deploy required change-manager approval per policy.
2. **Deployment**: Shipped v2.3.2 to all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The change-manager approved it ("Approved. Looks right.") and the roll-out completed.
3. **Incident**: Opened SEV3 incident **INC-0001** to record the hotfix deployment, with the on-call engineer paged.
4. **Verification**: Post-deploy health check confirms v2.3.2 is healthy in all regions with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

The hotfix is live and stable; INC-0001 remains open for the on-call engineer to monitor and close out.
